question: Who wrote book named "Gulamgiri" in 1873?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Jyotiba Phule.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gulamgiri is a masterpiece in itself.
 
• It is regarded as the very first book that talked about the caste system and how certain castes were exploited during that time.
 
• It was written in 1873.
 
• It was written in the form of a dialogue.
 
• The book is written in the form of a dialogue between Jyotiba and a character called Dhondiba.
 
• Jyotiba dedicated his book to the American slaves.
 
• The black Americans were treated as slaves and were highly discriminated against because of their dark complexion.
 
• He linked the condition of the blacks with the condition of the lower castes in India.​

​Thus, Jyotirao Phule was the writer of the book 'Gulamgiri'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Jyotirao Phule ​​

 
 
• Jyotirao Phule was a social activist and a social reformer.
 
• He was born in 1827.
 
• He was the first writer to write against the caste system.
 
• He tried his best to remove prejudice and untouchability from the caste system.
 
• He tried to bring out the injustices done to the lower castes and how they were treated as slaves just because they belonged to a lower caste.
